title: Concept: Template compiled from input (python) — review required
description: In python, render_template_string(tpl + name) turns a string into an executable template. Server-side template injection runs attacker expressions with application data access. The remedy is fixed templates with variable binding via render_template with variables.
applicability: python codebases compiling templates from assembled strings; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Server-side template injection leading to data theft or code execution; HIGH severity.
